The '''Condemned''' were the individuals who were descendants of [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] prison [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. By order of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], prisoners' descendants were not allowed to leave Belsavis, and the group became strongly opposed to the Republic under the leadership of the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Nyranos]]. They attacked the [[Prison Administration Center]] during the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Invasion of Belsavis|assault]] on Belsavis during the [[Galactic War]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Warden/Legends|Warden]] [[Playt]], though his successor Warden [[Graal]] was eventually convinced to strike a deal with Nyranos and form an alliance with them in return for improved living conditions and employment by the Republic.
